newsitem.title: KENYA: SOCCER-GERMANY'S FABISCH REPLACES VOJO AS KENYA COACH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GERMANY'S FABISCH REPLACES VOJO AS KENYA COACH.

text.p: German Reinhardt Fabisch was named Kenya's national soccer coach on Thursday, replacing sacked Montenegrian Gardesevic Vojo, the Kenya Football Federation (KFF) said.
KFF chairman Peter Kenneth said Fabisch had been appointed on a one-year contract, but gave no further details.
Vojo, appointed coach only in March, guided the team to an unexpected triumph in a World Cup Africa zone match against Algeria but Kenya lost their next five internationals without scoring a goal.
Since last coaching Kenya in 1987, Fabisch has served as a coach for Zimbabwe and South African club Mamelodi.
Fabisch's first assignment will be a World Cup qualifier against Guinea on November 10. "We have given him a free hand to create a winning outfit," Kenneth said.
Vojo complained he had been informed of his sacking only after Fabisch arrived in the Kenyan capital on Wednesday.
